title: Tile_18O_Isotopes: data and code for flow-dependent phosphate oxygen-isotope signatures in tile drainage
description: Continuous tile-drain discharge, water temperature, dissolved reactive phosphorus, dual water isotopes and phosphate oxygen isotopes (d18O-PO4) from two adjacent long-term tillage systems (conventional tillage and no-till) at the R.J. Cook Agronomy Farm LTAR site, Pullman, Washington, USA, September 2022 to July 2024, together with the complete R analysis pipeline that reproduces every table and figure in Arfania et al. (2026), Journal of Geophysical Research: Biogeosciences.
